blocks.text: 1. Khurdbeeni aaloodgi

Khurdbeeni aaloodgi pani ka bacteria, viruses, protozoa aur parasites jaise nuqsan-deh khurdbeeni jandaron se aaloodah hona hai, jo insanon aur janwaron ko sakht nuqsan de sakte hain. Yeh aam taur par na saaf ya kam saaf kiye sewage, janwaron ke fuzle, hospital ke kachre aur kheton se behte pani se aati hai. Aise pani mein aam jarasim Escherichia coli, Salmonella aur Giardia hain. Pani ke khurdbeeni jandaar pani se phailne wali bimariyon, jaise cholera, typhoid, pechish (dysentery) aur hepatitis A, ki bari wajah hain. Pani ubalna (100 C) zyada tar bacteria, viruses aur protozoa maar kar pani peene ke qabil banata hai, lekin sirf ubalne se doosri aaloodgi nahi nikalti.

blocks.alt: Aag par rakha pani ka bartan, oopar Boiling Water (100 °C) likha hai aur bhaap uth rahi hai. Pani mein bacteria, virus aur narangi toote hue tukre hain. Pani ki satah se lakeer Intact Bacteria/Virus (sabit jarasim) tak, aur aag se lakeer Broken Microbe Structure (toote hue jarasim) tak jati hai.
blocks.caption: Ubalne se zyada tar bacteria, viruses aur protozoa mar jate aur pani peene ke qabil hota hai, magar doosri aaloodgi sirf ubalne se door nahi hoti (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: 100 °C par garmi jarasim ki banawat (structure) tor deti hai: oopar 'Intact' sabit jarasim hain, neeche 'Broken' toote hue. Lekin heavy metals, nitrates ya pesticides ubalne se khatam nahi hote, balke pani bhaap bane to un ka concentration thora barh jata hai.
2. Kimiyai aaloodgi: heavy metals

Kimiyai aaloodgi mein aksar mercury, lead, arsenic aur cadmium jaisi zehreeli heavy metals aur pesticides aur herbicides jaise zarai kimiyai maddey shamil hain. Heavy metals sanati ikhraj, kaan kani aur kachre ke ghalat thikane lagane se pani mein aati hain.

items: Mercury zyada tar koyla jalane, sone ki kaan kani, aur thermometer ya battery banane ke sanati kachre se pani mein aati hai. Tah (sediments) mein bacteria inorganic mercury ko methylmercury ([CH3Hg]+) mein badalte hain, jo zyada khatarnak hai.

Lead ke bare zaraye leaded petrol (ab duniya bhar mein mamnoo), purani plumbing (lead ke pipes), lead-acid batteries aur paints hain. Lead ions (Pb2+) aksar pipes ke zang (corrosion) se pani mein aate hain.
Metal plating, plastic stabilisers aur phosphate khaad ki napaki pani mein cadmium ke bare zaraye hain.

blocks.text: Heavy metals ke atomic masses aur densities zyada hain. Kyunke yeh qudrati taur par galti nahi (non-biodegradable), yeh jandaron ke tissues mein jama hoti aur khaas taur par khatarnak hain. Methylmercury charbi mein bohat hal-pazeer hai, is liye aasani se hayatiyati jhilliyan paar karti aur biomagnification karti hai; yeh taqatwar neurotoxin hai jo khoon-dimagh ki rukawat paar karti, aur lamba samna Minamata bimari (ataxia, hathon pairon ka sun hona aur aam patthon ki kamzori) laata hai. Lead haemoglobin ki paidawar mein mudakhlat kar ke khoon ki kami (anaemia) karta hai; bachon mein yeh jama hone wala zehr hai jo na-qabil-e-wapsi asabi nuqsan aur nashonuma mein der karta hai. Cadmium ka taveel istemal itai-itai bimari laata hai, jis mein cadmium haddiyon mein calcium ki jagah le kar unhein bohat bhurbhura bana deta hai; yeh gurdon ko bhi sakht nuqsan (nephrotoxicity) deta hai.

blocks.alt: Baen taraf bara halka neela gola Ca2+, beech mein daen taraf teer jis par Ionic Displacement Potential likha hai, aur daen taraf chhota gehra neela gola Cd2+.
blocks.caption: Cd2+ ki charge density zyada hai, is liye yeh haddiyon mein Ca2+ ki jagah le leta hai (kitab ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono ions ka charge 2+ hai. Cd2+ (taqreeban 95 pm) Ca2+ (taqreeban 100 pm) se thora chhota hai, is liye us ki charge density thori zyada hai aur woh haddi mein calcium ki jagahon par baith jata hai. Kitab ki drawing mein size ka farq bara dikhaya gaya hai; asal mein dono ions qareeb qareeb barabar hain, isi liye Cd2+ itni aasani se fit hota hai.

blocks.title: Kya aap jante hain?
blocks.text: Minamata ka saniha 1950 ki dahai mein Minamata, Japan mein sanati aaloodgi ka shadeed waqia tha. Pani mein chhori gayi methylmercury se wasee mercury zehr phaila, hazaron log asabi nuqsan ka shikar hue aur paidaishi naqais, amwaat aur mahol ki tabahi hui. (Kitab ki mareez ki tasveer shamil nahi ki gayi.)
Kimiyai aaloodgi: pesticides aur herbicides

DDT aur glyphosate jaise pesticides aur herbicides aik aur khatarnak group hain jo pani ko aaloodah kar ke sehat ke sangeen masail paida karte hain. In ke bare zaraye kheton ka behta pani aur gharelu baghbani hain. Bohat se non-polar aur pani mein na-hal-pazeer lekin machhliyon aur parindon ke charbi wale tissues mein bohat hal-pazeer hain. DDT jaise bohat se purane pesticides der-pa organic aaloodgi (persistent organic pollutants, POPs) hain. Pesticides hormones ki kharabi aur nashonuma ke masail se jure hain, aur kimiyai aaloodgi pani ka mayaar girati, hayatiyati tanawwu kam karti aur aabi ecosystems bigarti hai.

blocks.title: Tamam pesticides non-polar nahi
blocks.text: Kitab DDT aur glyphosate jaise pesticides aur herbicides ko 'non-polar aur pani mein na-hal-pazeer' kehti hai. Yeh DDT par sahi hai, lekin glyphosate polar aur pani mein bohat hal-pazeer hai. Hissa 33.1 bhi batata hai ke polar pesticides ghul kar pani ke chakkar mein dakhil hote hain. Jaanch ke liye nishan zada.

Bohat se pesticides endocrine disruptors ka kaam karte hain jo oestrogen jaise qudrati hormones ki naqal karte hain. Is se jangli jandaron mein nasal-kashi ki nakami (maslan parindon ke ande ke chhilke ka patla hona) hoti aur insanon mein hormonal cancers se talluq hai. Polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) bijli ke transformers mein thanda karne ke liye use hote the; yeh khatarnak kachre ki jagahon se pani mein riste, mumkina insani carcinogens shumar hote, immune system dabate aur chloracne jaisi jild ki bimariyan paida karte hain.

blocks.alt: Insani jism ke aaza (organs), ran ka patha, tang ki haddi aur baazu ki khoon ki naliyan. Oopar baen spray karta shakhs (Pesticides), daen Cd, Pb, Cu, Zn ke saath Heavy Metals; dono se teer jism ki taraf. Labels: Alzheimer (dimagh); baen: Cardiac Failure, Lung Cancer, Hepatic Necrosis, Ovarian Cancer, Musculoskeletal Diseases; daen: Reducing Thyroid Hormone, Intravascular Hemolysis, Vomiting/Diarrhea, Renal Dysfunction, Osteoporosis.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Har label ki lakeer us uzw (organ) se nikalti hai jise nuqsan hota hai: dil (cardiac failure), phephre (lung cancer), jigar (hepatic necrosis), thyroid (hormone kam), khoon (haemolysis), maida (ulti/dast), gurde (renal dysfunction), haddi (osteoporosis). Kitab mein Pesticides wala teer dono taraf nok wala (double-headed) chhapa hai; zehr sirf jism mein jata hai, is liye yahan Heavy Metals ki tarah aik taraf ka teer banaya gaya hai.
3. Eutrophication

Ghizai ajza ki aaloodgi, jise eutrophication bhi kehte hain, tab hoti hai jab ghizai ajza, khaas taur par nitrogen aur phosphorus, ki zyada miqdar aam taur par kheton ke behte pani, gande pani ke ikhraj aur toofani pani se aabi zakhiron mein dakhil ho. Agarche yeh ajza paudon ki barhotri ke liye zaruri hain, in ki zyadti algae ki tez barhotri (algal blooms) karti hai. Blooms pani ke andar paudon tak dhoop rok sakte hain. Jab algae mar kar galti hain to bohat oxygen kharch karti hain, aur kam oxygen wale 'murda ilaqe' (dead zones) bante hain jahan aabi zindagi zinda nahi reh sakti. Eutrophication aabi ecosystems bigarti, hayatiyati tanawwu kam karti, machhli ki sanat ko nuqsan deti aur pani ko peene aur tafreeh ke liye kharab karti hai. Peene ke pani mein zyada nitrate khaas taur par shir-khwar bachon ke liye khatarnak hai aur 'blue baby syndrome' (methaemoglobinaemia) kar sakta hai, jis mein nitrates khoon ki oxygen le jane ki salahiyat kam karte hain.

blocks.alt: Paanch dabbe teeron se jure: zyada N aur P (khaad, sewage); algae ki tez barhotri (bloom); bloom dhoop rok leta hai; murda algae gal kar oxygen kharch karti; dead zone jahan aabi zindagi mar jati.
blocks.caption: Eutrophication ka silsila (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki Figure 33.3(a) tasveer hai).

blocks.text: 4. Tel

Samandaron mein tel ki aaloodgi, khaas taur par jahazon ke rasao aur girne se, mahol ke liye bara khatra hai. Gira hua tel pani ki satah par tezi se aik tah ki shakal mein phailta hai jo dhoop rokti aur oxygen ka tabadla kam karti hai. Is se machhliyon, parindon aur mammals samet samandari zindagi ko sakht nuqsan hota hai; samandari mammals apni safai karte hue zehreela tel nigal sakte hain, aur machhliyan hydrocarbons se taveel nuqsan utha sakti hain. Tel ki aaloodgi mangroves, coral reefs aur sahilon jaise sahili maskanon ko bhi nuqsan deti hai.

blocks.alt: Pani ki satah par tel ki kaali tah. Suraj ki roshni ka teer tah par ruk jata (laal X), aur O2 ka teer bhi pani mein dakhil nahi hota (laal X). Neeche pani mein machhli.
blocks.caption: Tel ki tah dhoop aur oxygen rokti hai (hamara apna khaaka; kitab ki Figure 33.3(b) tasveer hai).

blocks.text: 5. Plastic aur thos kachra

Samandaron aur doosre aabi zakhiron mein plastic aur thos kachre ki aaloodgi barhta hua mahol ka bohran hai. Har saal karoron ton plastic kachra, botlein, thaile, machhli ke jaal aur microplastics samet, daryaon, jheelon aur samandaron mein phenka jata hai. Organic maddon ke bar-aks plastics qudrati taur par nahi galte; yeh chhote zarrat mein toot kar sadiyon tak rehte hain. Samandari janwar aksar plastic ko khurak samajh lete, jis se nigalna, dam ghutna ya andaruni chot hoti jo jaan-leva ho sakti hai, aur purane machhli ke saaman aur doosre malbe mein phansna be-shumar kachhuon, dolphins aur parindon ko zakhmi ya halak karta hai. Microplastics food chain mein dakhil ho chuke hain, jis se insani sehat par un ke asraat ki fikr hai. Thos kachra aabi raaste band karta, aabi maskan bigarta aur pani ka mayaar girata hai.
